notes: Your bot now reports its own build: /status shows the version and the 'can't transcribe' message carries the build number. One glance at the chat tells you whether the fixes on a far-away Mac have arrived.
notes_zh: 你的 bot 现在会报告自己的版本：/status 显示版本号，“无法转写”的消息里也带构建号。在聊天里看一眼，就知道远程那台电脑上的修复到了没有。

v1.0.23.en: Voice replies no longer repeat the "I heard" receipt — the display header leaked into chat history and the model learned to parrot it. It is now stripped from output, never stored, and polluted histories are healed at startup.
v1.0.23.zh: 语音回复不再重复“我听到”回执——显示用的回执头曾进入聊天历史，模型学会了鹦鹉学舌。如今它从模型输出中剥离、永不被存储，被旧版本污染的历史会在启动时自动治愈。
